title: Minimum Total Space Wasted With K Resizing Operations
goal: Minimize wasted capacity with at most k resizing operations.
strategy: Partition demand into at most k+1 contiguous segments. Each segment needs its maximum demand as capacity, giving waste maximum times length minus segment sum.
